title: Three renderers share money, padding, and truncation formatting
task: We render a sales report as plain text, CSV, and Markdown. All three need money formatting (`1234567` -> `12,345.67`), right-padding to a column width, and truncating a name to twenty characters with an ellipsis. Implement `Text`, `CSV`, and `Markdown` renderers over a slice of `Sale{Name string; Cents int}` and put the shared pieces where a reader would look for them.
